description: Deterministic delivery of .cursor/rules/*.mdc to Codex sessions.

hooks.commandWindows: python -X utf8 -c "from pathlib import Path; import runpy; p=Path.cwd().resolve(); h=next(r/'.codex/hooks/attach_rules.py' for r in (p,*p.parents) if (r/'.codex/hooks/attach_rules.py').is_file()); runpy.run_path(str(h),run_name='__main__')"

python -X utf8 -c "from pathlib import Path; import runpy; p=Path.cwd().resolve(); h=next(r/'.codex/hooks/attach_rules.py' for r in (p,*p.parents) if (r/'.codex/hooks/attach_rules.py').is_file()); runpy.run_path(str(h),run_name='__main__')"
